title: VUA catalog-sync library-page request v0.1
description: One archived BOOTH account-library listing page reported by the Electron partition-session reader to the provider (docs/protocols/catalog-sync-v0.1). The page carries observed page facts only: raw HTML, the page URL, and the fetch time. Requests never carry cookies, session tokens or credentials; pageNumber and runId are correlation metadata the provider records but does not derive behavior from.

sourceUrl.description: The page URL the HTML was fetched from (the account library pagination URL).

html.description: The archived page body verbatim; parsing and closed-set validation happen provider-side.

pageNumber.description: Optional page ordinal for correlation and logging; not used to select parsing behavior.

fetchedAt.description: RFC 3339 observation time of the fetch (never a BOOTH publish time).

libraryType.description: v0.2: which account library the page lists (BDL v0.3 column). Optional; v0.1 requests omit it.

runId.description: Optional sync-run identity stamped into every observation written by this page.
